overview: Hobbins was nine days on the way. He took the letter of the last of August, still sealed, and gave you Anne's, written the Sunday after you left, and a parcel from Henley Street tied with a knot of great confidence. You read her letter in the yard and again by the taproom window. It answers a letter she has not yet had. You did not open the parcel.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Gave the sealed letter, read hers twice, and left the parcel tied.

parties.name: Thomas Hobbins
parties.context: Came in after nine days, took the letter of the last of August, and gave him hers and the parcel.

parties.name: Anne Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote it the Sunday after he left. She has not yet had the last of August.

parties.name: John Shakespeare
parties.context: Told the Cross the frame was raised single-handed. Not present.

parties.name: Hamnet Sadler
parties.context: Let that telling stand. Not present.

parties.name: Susanna Shakespeare
parties.context: Said the girl at the window said yes too quick. Not present.

parties.name: Judith Shakespeare
parties.context: Said the girl did right. Not present.

parties.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
parties.context: Said the boy should have brought a ladder, and rope. Not present.

key_provisions.text: when it falls and not before
